create_tracing_config: create a TracingConfig to configure symbolic tracing with a custom torch.fx.Tracer and concrete arguments
build_exec_order_tracer: build an _ExecOrderTracer to patch a tracer and record module and parameter execution order during symbolic tracing
test_execution_info: test the _ExecutionInfo class that captures module forward order and parameter usage order from a forward pass
review_param_usage_info: review the _ParamUsageInfo NamedTuple that records which parameters are used together in module execution
summarize_patch_tracer: summarize the _ExecOrderTracer.patch_tracer context manager that overrides call_module and create_proxy to track execution order
